export function getEventFormStatusLightVariant(
  status: string
): StatusLightProps['variant'] {
  switch (status.toLowerCase()) {
    case 'published':
      return 'positive'
    case 'cancelled':
      return 'negative'
    case 'archived':
      return 'neutral'
    case 'draft':
    default:
      return 'neutral'
  }
}
